headline:
Condos are slowing down
in [[91 of 97]] major cities.
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: New data says the slowdown blamed on Florida is happening in nearly every major U.S. market.
pullquote: Condo values have gained just 1% nationwide in four years, against 6% for houses. Florida's version is sharper, not different.

stats.label: days the average Florida condo sits unsold

video_second: Not a Florida problem. The new math on condos, everywhere.
